svg.title: Recommendation matrix: web framework fit by purpose
svg.desc: Editorial fit of each framework for each purpose; every cell has a basis in recommendations.csv. An empty cell means the framework is not recommended for that purpose on this page.
svg.text: Recommendation matrix: web framework fit by purpose
